why: P3: what each page loads before it runs, gzip-compressed, in KB (scripts/page-weights.mts): the weights measured 2026-11-24 after 64bbdc3b, plus 10 percent, rounded up. A page past its budget fails the build; raise a budget only with its reason written in BUILD-STATUS. index.html raised 142 to 190 on 2026-11-24: its two web fonts (45 KB) are now preloaded in its HTML, so the measure counts them (the page always loaded them); the game page's budget already counted them. play.html lowered 572 to 297 on 2026-11-24: a first visit preloads only the entry and the standalone hatch screen (FirstVisit.tsx), 270 KB; the rest of the game is preloaded only where a pet is saved, which this measure does not count. agents, handheld, numbers, tree and verify raised on 2026-11-24 to their new weight plus 10 percent: their two web fonts (about 44 KB) are now preloaded in their HTML, so the measure counts them (the pages always loaded them). privacy and terms added on 2026-11-24 (P6) at their first weight, 132.3 KB, plus 10 percent. 404 and circuits added on 2026-11-27 (R27): both moved from public/ into the build to carry the brand, so they now load the shared header, tokens and the two web fonts; their first weights in CI, 48.6 KB and 53.4 KB, plus 10 percent.
